text:
Priya: AM async — quick standup. What I did: wired up adaptive-batch-slotting experiment and migrated kv-shard-rebalancer to dev branch. Ran an overnight bench comparing baseline -> adaptive slotting. Summary: p50 about the same, p95 dropped from ~520ms -> ~430ms on small-shard workloads. Blockers: saw a host with CPU spikes during slot churn, need to confirm compaction vs scheduling. Today: triage CPU, add a rate-limiter to slot adjustments, push a 10% canary, and open PR for rebalance config.

Ben: nice! can you paste the bench link and the exact args used? pinging @Luca for kernel review.

Luca: looked at the logs — interesting signal. my hunch: rapid slot reallocations cause extra kernel spin (hot CAS loops). suggest adding a short cooldown or token-bucket on slot changes. also share the PR id and i'll review.

Priya: bench link: https://internal/bench/slot-util-2026-03-17 — sample metrics line: "p95 430ms, p99 980ms, cpu 68%". config snippet used: ```batch.window_ms=8
batch.max_slots=32
kv.eviction_policy=adaptive
kv.rebalance_interval=60s``` PR: #3421 — will add notes and repro steps.

Ashley: re: CPU spike — i can run a flamegraph on the host after the next run. prefer we gate the canary to 10% until p99 stabilizes. also, watch disk iowait in case compactor is involved.

infra-bot: Deploy queued by Priya — canary rollout to dev-cluster-3 scheduled at 2026-03-17T14:00Z. :rocket: (10% traffic)

Sam: skimmed PR, left two comments about lock scope in slotter; nothing blocking otherwise. LGTM after those are addressed. :thumbsup: 

Priya: thanks Sam — addressing CR comments now. plan: add rate-limiter + telemetry for slot churn (emit slot_change_rate per-minute), re-run bench with ctx_len=1024 as requested, include a quantized-model variant bench as @Ben requested. will kick the 10% canary once rate-limiter is in.

Ben: small ask — please include a longer context test (ctx=1024) since slot occupancy changes with longer seqs. also include a run with quantized kernel if feasible.

Luca: agree. kernel-quant paths sometimes change memory pressure and could affect slot eviction patterns. add a bench with quant-8bit.

Ashley: noted, i'll queue the flamegraph after Priya's next bench. tagging for follow-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Updated checklist in-thread: [1] fix CR comments (in progress) [2] add slotter rate-limiter + telemetry (in progress) [3] schedule 10% canary (blocked until rate-limiter) [4] run ctx=1024 + quant-8bit benches (queued). Expect next status ~6h. Thanks everyone.
